text:
anya: quick unit-econ scan — we're picking a cheaper default for chat. comparing pioneer6b-int4 vs atlast-8b-int8. any quick recs on cost vs quality tradeoffs?

mike: rough numbers from bench earlier today: pioneer ~90 tok/s, p50 ~90ms. atlast ~60 tok/s, p50 ~120ms. cost per 1k toks: pioneer ~$0.0025, atlast ~$0.0045. so atlast ~1.8x cost.

cheng: quality quick notes on our eval set (retrieval + convo): atlast wins on factuality/QA F1 by ~5 pts. pioneer drops on long contexts (>1024) and has ~+3% hallucination rate vs atlast. short-chat quality is comparable.

eva: product POV: users care latency for interactive chat. cost matters for freemium scale. suggested routing: default->pioneer, fallback->atlast for long contexts or low-confidence replies. Also recommend a short canary with explicit eval prompts.

mike: agree. TL;DR: save ~45% unit-cost with pioneer but expect a 3–5% hit on retrieval QA metrics. For safety, canary 2 weeks at 20% traffic + golden prompt evals.

anya: can someone drop a 1-line scorecard I can copy into GTN notes?

cheng: mini scorecard (quick snapshot):
```
Model | Cost/1k | P50 | F1_retrieval | Halluc %
pioneer6b-int4 | $0.0025 | 90ms | 78.4 | 7.2
atlast-8b-int8  | $0.0045 | 120ms | 83.6 | 4.0
```

mike: routing flag suggestion: `route.model=pioneer6b-int4; route.fallback=atlast-8b-int8; route.threshold=0.72` (threshold = confidence/predictive score)

eva: noted — I'll draft the GTN guidance: expected monthly savings estimate (based on current traffic) + canary checklist + rollback criteria (quality regression >2% on golden set or error rate increase).

sre-bot: deploy note: canary rollout scheduled 2024-07-25 09:00 UTC for 2 weeks, 20% traffic. See /deploys/2024-07-25 for logs.

anya: perfect — thanks all. we'll reconvene after the canary and share the cost/quality delta. :thumbsup:
